text:
Ellen: FYI — after the streaming API rollout last night (proto framing + SSE coalesce) p90 for short chat requests jumped ~45ms in prod. Putting the rollout on hold.
Priya: Oof. Is there a CI perf reg for this or just prod signal?
Tom: CI perf job failed on the perf/staging-runner with a 30ms regression on the sse-smoke test. Link: https://ci.internal/reports/2026/streaming-perf/2019
perf-bot: perf-ci: job perf/staging-runner #482 failed; median latency +28ms; suspect range: 2026-03-16..2026-03-17
Jordan: Quick profiling on a repro shows more time in serialization (json/tool-call marshalling). Also noticed kernel routing shifted for small batches — fallback to generic fp32 path instead of quantized kernel.
Ellen: That kernel switch could explain token-side CPU increase. Any idea why routing picked fp32? we didn't change model metadata afaik.
Tom: There's a commit that touched model flavor metadata + sse framing: commit ab12f3d — it added a header coalescing optimization. Reverting locally makes p90 go back down.
Priya: Can you paste the perf flame/top? Also check KV cache hit patterns — we saw more kv eviction churn in prod traces.
Tom: Paste of top lines (local repro):
```
serialize_json->toolcall_marshal  18ms
kv_cache_eviction                 12ms
kernel_dispatch(fp32_generic)     22ms
sse_frame_coalesce                10ms
```
Jordan: So two things: header coalescing increases serialization bufferization (adds a handful ms) and the model metadata tweak nudged the kernel selector to not match the quantized path. Combined they stack.
Ryan: Confirmed on a staging flamegraph — kv cache TTLs for short-prefix requests spiked (more evictions) when batching heuristics increased average batch size unexpectedly after the framing change.
Ellen: Action items: 1) rollback ab12f3d from the rollout (hold already), 2) add an env flag to disable sse coalesce at runtime (hotfix), 3) run a bisect on kernel selector change + model metadata, 4) run a focused kv-cache regression test.
Priya: I'll open the rollback PR and the hotfix flag now. Tom/Jordan, can you do a bisect and add unit perf tests covering small-batch kernel selection?
Tom: Starting bisect now. Command I'm running: `git bisect start --bad HEAD --good v2026-03-10; git bisect run ./run_streaming_perf.sh --short-requests`
Tom: Early note: bisect points at a merge that adjusted model flavor inference logic 2 commits before ab12f3d. Suspect: selector path uses `model_meta.is_fp16 == false` fallback when header is coalesced.
Jordan: I'll instrument the kernel selector with a lightweight metric to verify paths in staging. Also adding kv cache histograms to traces.
perf-bot: perf-ci: added perf test target 'small-batch-kernel' to the CI matrix per request.
Ellen: Great — keep updates here. If rollback PR lands, coordinate with infra to unpin canary so we can redeploy quickly. :thumbsup:
